title_suffix: reviewed closeout and faster classic changes
summary: OSpec 1.8.17 is the cumulative release of the previously unreleased 1.8.16 and 1.8.17 work since 1.8.15. Goal closeout can bind a later authoritative task-review snapshot and synchronizes visible worker status across all shipped languages. The classic Change profile is now a complete fast path: user-selected Changes never auto-promote to Goals, use compact stage-aware guidance and current-AI review, enforce practical documentation policy, derive closeout state automatically, and finalize queued work without manual skill or index steps.
new: Added path-specific final-state authorization through a later fully validated task-review snapshot.
Added localized visible status synchronization for worker-status closeout sections.
Added ospec change as the preferred classic creation command while retaining ospec new as a compatible alias.
Added localized compact change-protocol.md guidance for stage-aware Change execution.
Added a canonical Classic Change closeout service for documentation, review, plugin, and derived-state gates.
improved: Keeps dispatch documentation evidence immutable while allowing independently reviewed controller closeout metadata.
Recognizes Combined review checklist text in English, Chinese, Japanese, and Arabic.
Clarifies that the unknown-capacity implementation cap of two is a replaceable safety fallback rather than a global or review concurrency limit.
Skips per-commit file-history scans when local structured release metadata is already complete.
Keeps every user-selected Change on the classic profile regardless of complexity, flags, file count, risk, or batch size.
Lets the current AI perform one lightweight review and auto-close APPROVED or APPROVED_WITH_CONCERNS results.
Runs batch Changes sequentially through the existing queue and archive-chain shared-worktree flow.
Rebuilds indexes once during successful finalize instead of before and after archive.
Runs only Change-relevant verification and stops forcing manual SKILL or index checklist work.
fixed: Fixed verification.md closeout metadata being rejected even when a fresh authoritative task review exactly covered the current file.
Fixed localized Combined review checkboxes remaining unchecked after ospec execute sync.
Fixed visible worker-status section states remaining PENDING after authoritative statuses reached terminal values.
Fixed feature and docs Changes being able to close without a real durable documentation path.
Fixed generated archive summaries, ordinary configuration files, and directories being accepted as feature documentation.
Fixed ospec update omitting the compact Change protocol from update provenance.
Fixed Classic archive checks reading legacy Goal task-graph documentation evidence.
Fixed the ospec new compatibility alias displaying ospec change usage on errors.
docs: Documented the AIHub post-1.8.15 closeout incident, strict review-snapshot fallback conditions, localized sync behavior, and no-replay recovery path.
Documented compact Change creation, current-AI review, documentation contracts, queue execution, derived closeout, automatic archive, and upgrade behavior.
